collection_metadata: feasibility/metadata.json and repeated/metadata.json preserve actual CPU placement and chain identities
common_scoring: ViennaRNA 2.7.2, Turner2004, 37C, dangles0, special hairpins enabled, standard genetic code. Full decimal-table log codon penalty recomputed independently.
comparison_policy: LD/LCD retain native internal and multiloop restrictions and binary32 frequency conventions; no strict matched-model speed ratios. DERNA lambda0 only eligible following parameter, source, and per-output physics verification. Lambda4 native quality is rescored in common full-precision arithmetic.
feasibility: Ascending amino-acid length independently per tool and lambda; one attempt per condition. After first timeout or allocation failure, all longer conditions in that chain are explicitly not attempted. Wrapper/parser errors stop the collection for diagnosis.
fixes: LinearDesign relative DT_NEEDED path supported with temporary src symlink
DERNA derived codon-table LF delimiters to avoid upstream untrimmed header tokens
LinearCDSfold uppercase Folding free energy parsed
Resume inputs/settings/raw-output hashes checked; interrupted evidence preserved
host: arrakis; dual AMD EPYC 7313, 1 TiB RAM
host_load: Shared server whose load varied during the measurements. Native records retain initial load averages, not before/after CPU utilization snapshots.
repetitions: Five fresh randomized repetitions for every feasible condition. Pilot and feasibility attempts excluded from timing summaries. The same resource caps apply to repetitions.
timing_boundary: Complete native CLI process, including initialization, allocation, traceback, output, native serialization and native refolding. Input/output validity and common scoring run outside timed boundaries.
